data.description:
Create a shared pickFields() projection helper that projects work items to only the requested fields, with validation against a known field whitelist and guaranteed inclusion of id.

File: packages/shared/src/fields.ts
Export: pickFields(item, fields) - rejects unknown field names, always includes id, returns full item when fields undefined.
Valid field list: id, title, description, status, stage, priority, issueType, assignee, tags, createdAt, updatedAt, parentId, needsProducerReview, sortIndex

Acceptance Criteria:
1. pickFields(item, ["id", "title"]) returns object with only id and title
2. pickFields(item, ["nonexistent"]) throws/returns error listing valid fields
3. pickFields(item, []) returns object with only id
4. pickFields(item, undefined) returns the full item (no projection when not requested)

Key Files:
- packages/shared/src/fields.ts (new)
- packages/shared/src/types.ts (export)
